change_markers.sealed_text: Hitting the soft cap writes status partial and a cursor; the next run resumes and does not drop unfinished names quietly.
change_markers.what_was_wrong: The second fetch (run 43287164973, 2026-11-12 19:09-21:09 UTC) hit the 120-minute job limit, which cannot hold ~26.7k requests at <=5/s. The cursor was saved only at the end, so its done-flags and the day's call count were lost; cache files were written in place, so a cancelled write could leave a truncated file that resume would skip; and the encrypt step failed on tar's 'file changed as we read it' warning (the encrypted cache was still saved).
change_markers.fix: Job limit 350 minutes; the runner stops itself after UK_REPLAY_MAX_MINUTES (320) as partial/time_budget; the cursor is saved every 25 names; every cache file is written atomically; a cache file that does not parse is fetched again; the encrypt step tolerates tar exit 1.
change_markers.unchanged: No constant, window, call weight, soft cap or scoring rule changed. Files already fetched are kept and skipped on resume.

change_markers.sealed_text: Availability ... Stale when the period end is more than STALE_FILING_DAYS 456 before the session. revenue_growth: prior <= 0, or either year not visible. interim_revenue: the quarter within 45 days of one year earlier. Age <= 460 days. STALE_FILING_DAYS 456: matches US. Section 9: a bug fix is an amendment, and development is recomputed before the reveal.
change_markers.what_was_wrong: The runner applied the 456-day staleness (and the 460-day interim age) to the prior-year comparator as well as the latest statement. With no filing date a statement is visible 182 days after its year end, when the prior year's period end is 547 days old, so the year-on-year revenue, margin, EPS and FCF checks and the screen's prior-year columns were almost never evaluable (development bias: revenue not evaluable for 89% of ranked still-listed names). The US rehearsal, which the constant matches, applies staleness to the latest statement only.
change_markers.fix: Staleness and the interim age limit apply to the latest statement; the prior year (and the year-earlier quarter) needs only to be visible. Development is recomputed with develop --amend (workflow phase development-amendment); the superseded block's summary and sha256 are logged in the store's amendments.
change_markers.unchanged: No constant, threshold, window, universe rule or call budget changed. The holdout has not been read. Development committed 2026-11-13 15:04 UTC is superseded, not deleted from the record.
